name: Community / recreation center
summary: Municipal community/recreation centers combine a high-volume gymnasium (and often an elevated track) with multipurpose rooms, fitness, a catering kitchen and lockers; adding an indoor pool is the single biggest cost swing. Evidence is moderate: one hard GMP (Des Moines 2024, with pool, ~$595/SF), the Virginia state database (multipurpose $555, gym $693, 2026) and a large Colorado center (~$760/SF); a dry (no-pool) center is set at ~$525/SF.

typicalSize.method: Neighborhood community center ~15-25k SF; full recreation center with gym/fitness 30-50k SF (Reichardt 36,637 SF, e2); regional multi-pool centers 80k-110k SF (e3 108,000 SF). VA multipurpose median 52,944 SF (e4).

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Building SF per site acre; one-story center with surface parking (~4 per 1,000 SF), stormwater and outdoor courts/playground typically 3-6 acres for 35k SF. Derived.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Spaces per SF (= 3-5 per 1,000 SF), typical code for assembly/recreation buildings. Derived.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Hard cost incl. sitework per building SF for a dry (no indoor pool) community/recreation center. Anchors: VA multipurpose center $555 (2026, e4); Des Moines Reichardt $595 (2024, incl. pool and site, e2); VA gymnasium $693 (2026, e5); Grand Junction $760 (2024, multi-pool, e3). Removing the pool premium from Reichardt (pool hall typically ~15-20% of cost) gives ~$500/SF; mid $525 sits between that and the VA multipurpose average. Low $375 = simple pre-engineered gym + rooms in a low-cost market; high $750 = gym/pool-heavy regional center (e3, e5). RSMeans 2019 ($145-$189 incl. A/E, e6/e7) retained as stale references.

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. GC/OH&P, gym flooring and fixed gym equipment, on-site parking/utilities/landscaping; EXCLUDES indoor pool/natatorium (add line item), outdoor sports fields, land, soft costs, loose FF&E/fitness equipment, off-sites and fees.

qualityTiers.method: Economy ~ $375/$525; premium ~ gym-heavy $693 (e5) / $555 (e4) = 1.25; luxury ~ regional destination center $760+ (e3) ~ 1.45-1.5.

systemSplit.method: Derived. Trade list follows the Des Moines Reichardt CMAR bid packages (concrete, precast, masonry, structural steel, metal panels, roofing, glazing, framing/gyp/ACT, wood gym flooring, gym equipment, elevators, fire protection, plumbing/HVAC/geothermal, electrical/low voltage, earthwork/utilities, site concrete, landscaping; e1), but package dollar amounts are not published, so percentages are set from a typical steel-framed long-span recreation building with pool-related Div 13 excluded.

lineItems.name: Indoor pool / natatorium (6-lane lap + leisure, incl. pool hall share)

cost.method: Derived: Reichardt (with pool) at ~$595/SF vs. ~$500/SF dry-center equivalent implies ~$3.5M pool premium on 36,637 SF (e1/e2); multi-pool regional centers (e3) run much higher.

lineItems.notes: Optional; dehumidification, pool mechanical, tile and deck-level glazing drive cost.

lineItems.name: Gymnasium wood floor, backstops, divider curtain, scoreboards

cost.method: Derived allowance for one 2-court gym; Reichardt bid packages include 09E wood gym flooring and 11E gymnasium equipment (e1).
Derived allowance (warming kitchen low; full commercial kitchen with hood and grease interceptor high).
Derived allowance; Reichardt site scope includes a futsal court and playground site prep (e1).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Derived: loose furniture, fitness equipment, AV and IT for multipurpose rooms; fitness-heavy centers at the high end.

pctOfHard.method: Derived from public-building norms: A/E 7%-9%, CM/owner's rep 2%-4%, permits/testing/commissioning 2%-3%, surveys/legal/insurance 1%-2%, public engagement/art 1%. Excludes FF&E and contingency.

softCosts.notes: CMAR delivery (e1) adds a preconstruction services fee (Des Moines: $60,518 pre-con agreement) that is small relative to the GMP.

hard.method: Derived; under CMAR the GMP itself carries CM contingencies (e1), so the owner hard contingency can sit at the lower end.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Low ~ $375 hard x 1.15; high ~ pool-heavy center at ~$760-$850 hard (e3) x 1.3.

source.title: Council Communication No. 24-362: GMP Amendment 2 with J.E. Dunn Construction for the North Side Community Recreation Center

evidence.quote: for a total cost not to exceed $21,812,538 for the North Side Community Recreation Center project, subsequently to be known as the Reichardt Community Recreation Center.
evidence.scopeNotes: CMAR guaranteed maximum price (cost of work + contingencies + CM fee), Sept 2024. Program: indoor pool, gymnasium with elevated track, fitness, community and multipurpose rooms, locker rooms; site: parking, stormwater, walks, trail, futsal court, playground prep. Bid packages listed by CSI division (03A concrete ... 32G landscaping).

source.title: Recreation Center Construction Cost Per Square Foot (2026)

evidence.quote: The city's parks department describes the finished facility as a 36,637-square-foot public recreation facility. ... Dividing the GMP by that floor area gives roughly $595 per square foot.
evidence.scopeNotes: GMP (e1) / 36,637 SF; includes site work and an indoor pool, so above a dry community center.

source.title: Recreation Center Construction Cost Per Square Foot (2026)

evidence.quote: the final price for Grand Junction's 108,000-square-foot recreation center was $82.1 million ... Dividing the reported price by the floor area gives roughly $760 per square foot.
evidence.scopeNotes: Large multi-pool regional recreation center; unclear whether $82.1M is construction-only or total project - treat as upper reference.

source.title: RSMeans square foot cost model: Community Center (Decorative Concrete Block / Bearing Walls), 1 story

evidence.quote: Model page cost table (10,000 SF, 2019 data): SubTotal $107.49/SF; Contractor Fees 25%; Architectural Fees 8%; Total Building Cost $145.11/SF (union)
evidence.scopeNotes: Building only, union labor, 2019 national average; includes contractor GC/OH&P (25%) AND architect fees; excludes sitework, land, FF&E. Hard cost w/o A/E fee = SubTotal x 1.25. Stale (2019) and well below current bids; used for relative ratios between types only.

evidence.scopeNotes: Building only, union labor, 2019 national average; includes contractor GC/OH&P (25%) AND architect fees; excludes sitework, land, FF&E. Hard cost w/o A/E fee = SubTotal x 1.25. Stale (2019) and well below current bids; used for relative ratios between types only.

openQuestions: Only one hard GMP with known SF (Des Moines) - more municipal bid awards for dry community centers (no pool) are needed to firm the mid.
Pool premium is derived; a published natatorium cost breakout would replace it.
Reichardt SF (36,637) is from a secondary source citing the city parks page.
